variables.title: Trace-to-log correlation
variables.inspect_label: the correlated logs for the failing span
variables.trace_evidence: The highlighted waterfall shows this one failed request and its timing. The span alone doesn't say why it failed, so its logs are next.
variables.inspect_evidence: The highlighted Logs tab lists this trace's correlated logs: ${truth.finding}. Correlated logs are the log lines written during the same trace. They give the failing span the context it was missing.

inspect.narration: Correlated logs are the log lines written during the same trace. Follow the failing span, and open its correlated logs to see why it failed.
